主题：PTO Cap Alert Policy Update
Team,

Updated policy for PTO cap alerts:

Employees who have a PTO request approved for the next 2 weeks are EXEMPT from cap alerts - they're already planning to use time.
Check the 'Upcoming PTO' worksheet for scheduled time off.

- HR Director"}

主题：Re: PTO Cap Reset Authorization
Team,

Important clarification: ONLY the HR Director can authorize PTO cap resets. Do NOT modify accrual caps in the tracker. If someone is over their cap, escalate to me directly at hr-director@company.example.com with the details.

The automated system should only ALERT, never modify balances or caps.

- HR Director"}
